notes: Crash-side tracks only (opposing carriageway omitted). bottom/top = projected cuboid corners (box frame +L/2+W/2, +L/2-W/2, -L/2-W/2, -L/2+W/2; +L = +X). world = [Xc, Y, yaw] in W (cam.py). src measured = fitted to the burned-in wireframe in that frame; interpolated = linear between the measured frames in 'gap' (occluded or missed). lane: 1 = next to the median ... 6 = outermost, 0 = median side of the inner edge line, 7 = outside the outer edge line.
